description: COUNTY LEVEL, PAST 365 DAYS. Recent Storms by Address (last 365 days). Use when the question is how much storm activity a county has had in the past year. Without a key, returns the exact price quote (address count and price at $0.05/address) and a pay link; with a key it returns the data. County grade and counts by storm type are a paid County Summary (summary=true, $0.02 per county). Input is state plus county, never a street address. Not for one property (use get_address_report), not for the 2003-to-present record (use get_property_storm_history_report), not for future storms (use get_risk_forecast). Not a damage assessment. For the paid address-level list, call get_weather_data with dataset=storms and addresses=true ($0.05 per address; pay with an Atlas United API key, x402, or the card pay link).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity, e.g. 1.75 for golf-ball hail.

peril.description: Storm/risk type filter. Used by dataset=storms and dataset=risk (narrows to one storm type) and by dataset=at_risk (narrows to one peril bucket). Common storms/risk values: HAIL, THUNDERSTORM_WIND, FLASH_FLOOD, HEAVY_RAIN, FLOOD, TORNADO.

name: get_storm_history
title: Recent Storms by Address (county quote)
